did: Committed tokens/kestrel.tokens.json: five colour ramps, semantic colours for background, text and border (including nominal, warning, offline and danger), spacing, radius, sizes, type styles, motion and a shadow, each with a note on when to use it. The token values were supplied; this step was about the workflow, not the Kestrel's look.
learned: I committed on an out-of-date local main while GitHub's main had moved on, so git made a merge commit instead of a pull request. Nothing broke. Now I pull before starting new work and do everything on a branch.
title: Design tokens for the cockpit
